messages:
emma: getting a 422 on tool.invoke when we include customer_tier in the payload. can someone double-check?

support-bot: Ticket #678912 created (severity: medium) — forwarding to @support.

jared: can you paste the request + response body? also which SDK/version?

emma: here's the curl and the API response we see:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"tool":"create_order","params":{"sku":"ABC123","quantity":"3","customer_tier":"enterprise"}}'
```
response (422):
```
{
  "error": "Request validation failed",
  "details": [
    {"path":"params.customer_tier","error":"additionalProperties not allowed"},
    {"path":"params.quantity","error":"expected integer, got string"},
    {"path":"params.tool","error":"required property missing or null"}
  ]
}
```
weird part: we did send `tool` in the body? but SDK might be reshaping payload. using sdk-js v0.9.2.

laura: two quick calls: 1) additionalProperties indicates the function schema doesn't include customer_tier (so server rejects). 2) quantity being a string explains the type error. also the tool missing error suggests the request that reached the validator has tool=null or stripped. that could be the SDK marshalling bug.

dan: does the raw request that hit our edge contain the same body? can you share the request-id from headers or logs? did you set Content-Type correctly (application/json) vs form-data?

emma: request-id: req_0a1b2c3d4e, content-type was application/json (attached full HAR). reproduced locally with curl above and got same 422.

maya: quick repro notes: i tried exact payload and got the same validation failure. submitting minimal fixed payload works:
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/invoke 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"tool":"create_order","params":{"sku":"ABC123","quantity":3}}'
```
No 422. So two actionables: convert numeric strings to ints on client or server-side coercion, and decide whether we want to accept customer_tier as an extension (additionalProperties) or explicitly add it to the function schema.

oliver: for short-term: we can relax the validator to allow additionalProperties for params and emit a warning in logs. long-term: add customer_tier to the create_order schema if it's a supported attribute. also note: if SDK strips `tool` during a client-side transform when params contain unexpected keys, that's a bug in sdk-js v0.9.2 — flagged to client team.

dan: marking this P2 -> escalate to eng-oncall if we see errors hitting production for >1% of requests. @jared assigning to you to triage.

jared: ack. will: 1) reproduce with request-id, 2) confirm whether SDK sent wrong shape, 3) patch validator to tolerate customer_tier or coerce numeric strings. I'll post timeline.

emma: thanks — request-id included above. happy to provide more logs.

jared: update: identified SDK marshalling bug when optional param keys are present (v0.9.2). patching client and adding a server-side lenient-parse flag to coerce numeric strings and ignore unknown extra props for params. aiming for a canary tomorrow 09:00 UTC. will follow up in this thread. :thumbsup:
